title: From Inverse Vandermonde Matrices to the Shift Structure of the Dirichlet Eta and Beta Functions
summary: We investigate the asymptotic behavior of the inverse of Vandermonde matrices with nodes drawn from the quadratic sequences u n = n 2 and u n = (n -1 2 ) 2 . We derive new limiting formulas for the entries of the inverses, expressed through the even and odd central factorial numbers. These formulas are then used to study the asymptotic behavior of a ratio of determinants involving a modified Vandermonde matrix.
